data.title: 天雨亚子 · 迎宾晚宴上的优雅行政官
data.description: 学园政商名流云集的迎宾大宴会厅，璀璨的水晶吊灯倾泻下万道流光。亚子换上一袭深蓝近夜色的露背晚礼服，白皙无瑕的美背在华灯下耀眼夺目。她优雅地端着香槟杯侧身回眸，看到携伴而来的老师时，端庄的面具下悄悄泛起了一抹羞涩的红晕。
data.action: holding champagne glass, turning back gracefully, showing backless cut, subtle blush
data.lighting: dazzling sparkling chandelier brilliance and warm golden banquet illumination
data.mood: high-class elegance, aristocratic grace, and hidden flutter
data.promptProse: Inside an opulent grand ballroom under dazzling crystal chandeliers, Amau Ako turns gracefully in a midnight-blue backless evening gown, clutching a champagne flute with a bashful pout.
data.animaCaption: Ako looking back in a glamorous backless evening dress.
